The timeline shows six past events on the Atlas Logistics contract and two deadlines still to come. The most important date is **15 December 2026**. That's the last day to give written notice if you don't want the contract to renew. It's about 7 weeks from today [2].

**History**
- **14 Mar 2023:** the three-year contract was signed [1].
- **1 Apr 2023:** services started [1].
- **9 Feb 2024:** Amendment 1 raised prices by 3.5% and moved the fuel surcharge into the base rate [1].
- **Nov 2024:** Atlas received a notice for breaking its service-level agreement, after missing three delivery windows in October [1].
- **15 Jan 2025:** €18,400 in service credits was taken off the January invoice [1].
- **1 Apr 2026:** prices rose by 3.1%, which is below the 4% annual limit [1].

**Upcoming**
- **15 Dec 2026:** deadline for notice of non-renewal. Notice must be given at least 90 days before the current term ends [3].
- **15 Mar 2027:** the current term ends. If no notice was given, the contract renews automatically for one year [2].

If you'd rather end the contract before then, either side can also cancel at any time with 90 days' written notice [3].

redis.delta_text:
The timeline shows six past events on the Atlas Logistics contract and two deadlines still to come. The most important date is **15 December 2026**. That's the last day to give written notice if you don't want the contract to renew. It's about 7 weeks from today [2].

**History**
- **14 Mar 2023:** the three-year contract was signed [1].
- **1 Apr 2023:** services started [1].
- **9 Feb 2024:** Amendment 1 raised prices by 3.5% and moved the fuel surcharge into the base rate [1].
- **Nov 2024:** Atlas received a notice for breaking its service-level agreement, after missing three delivery windows in October [1].
- **15 Jan 2025:** €18,400 in service credits was taken off the January invoice [1].
- **1 Apr 2026:** prices rose by 3.1%, which is below the 4% annual limit [1].

**Upcoming**
- **15 Dec 2026:** deadline for notice of non-renewal. Notice must be given at least 90 days before the current term ends [3].
- **15 Mar 2027:** the current term ends. If no notice was given, the contract renews automatically for one year [2].

If you'd rather end the contract before then, either side can also cancel at any time with 90 days' written notice [3].
